title: Advice to learn to read; exercise books can kill feeling
summary: Hall urges players to read music, but warns about a young player who relies on exercise books and loses feeling.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
